basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate with a degree in Computer Science, currently living in Seattle. I have a keen interest in Python programming and am exploring ways to integrate it into various projects. I'm a big fan of outdoor activities, particularly hiking and kayaking in the Pacific Northwest. I work as a junior software developer and enjoy learning new technologies during my free time. I'm single and often spend my evenings online, especially on tech and education-related subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in computer science principles from my university education. I've been self-teaching Python through online courses and projects. My work as a junior developer involves a lot of hands-on coding, which helps me continuously improve my skills.
